title: buildzr config file (buildzr.yaml, version 1)
description: buildzr.yaml: the workspaces folder, the build options and the serve options. Text values may use ${NAME}, ${NAME:-fallback} and $$; they are expanded when a command uses them, so values that contain '$' are only checked for their type here. Secrets never go in this file. Relative paths are relative to the folder holding the file. A command-line option always wins over the file, and the file over the built-in default. The loader (buildzr.site.config) is the authority; this schema lets editors check the same rules.

workspaces.description: What to build. A path: the workspaces folder, whose Python files create the workspaces (a single .py file also works). Or a list of files and folders, each with its own build settings; only what is listed is built. -w replaces it. Default: workspaces.

oneOf.description: A .py file, or a folder whose Python files are all built.

path.description: A .py file, or a folder whose Python files are all built.

build.description: Build settings for the workspaces of this entry only; each wins over the same key of the global build:, and a command-line option wins over it. out is the same for every workspace, so it is not allowed here.

k.description: Room for a box that contains other boxes, in areas of an empty box; raise it if their insides are too small to read, lower it for compact diagrams.

text_color.description: Text colour on boxes, wcag or c4.

viewer.description: false builds data only, without the viewer.

out.description: The build output: build writes one folder per workspace here and serve reads it.

serve.description: Options of buildzr serve; buildzr build never reads them. Each one is used only when its command-line option is not given.

public_url.description: The address at which readers reach the server, for example behind a proxy: an http:// or https:// URL without query or fragment; a trailing / is dropped. The links of the Model API (viewerUrl) are built from it. Same as --public-url. Default: none, so the links start with /.

port.description: The port to listen on, 1 to 65535. Same as -p/--port. ${NAME} is not expanded here, because the value is a number.

host.description: The address to listen on. The default 127.0.0.1 lets only this machine connect; 0.0.0.0 shares the server with every machine on the network, and serve has no login. Same as --host.

cors_origins.description: Web origins (scheme://host[:port], no path, no '*') whose pages may read the Model API from a browser. An empty list means none. Same as repeating --cors-origin; the option replaces this list, it does not add to it.
